- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early forecast periods (first 5–10 days of 30d window).
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., 79.16 → 82.31) — model peaks too high and then undercorrects.
- Underestimates mean-reverting periods — model holds too high a mean, fails to adjust downward when prices stabilize.
- Lagged response to recent price drops — model takes 2–3 days to correct downward bias.
- Overconfidence in short-term momentum — model assumes trend continuation longer than actual mean reversion.
- High variance in forecast error near end of 30d window — model underperforms in final 5–7 days.
- Model tends to ignore recent low prices in history when forecasting — fails to recognize bottoming or reversal signals.
